scope: Empty One Health views and chart sizing lifecycle
reproduced_error: Failed to execute 'observe' on 'ResizeObserver': parameter 1 is not of type 'Element'.
cause: The sizing effect observed a missing SVG when the network rendered an empty state.
fix: The resize observer attaches through the element ref and disconnects when the element unmounts.

cases: Remembered zero network entry after tab navigation
All timeline layers disabled and restored
